checks.evidence: ZoteroLocalAdapter strictly enforces loopback hosts (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]); remote hosts and external IPs are rejected with ZoteroSecurityError.
Adapter exposes zero mutation methods and structurally blocks non-GET/HEAD HTTP methods locally before making network calls.
Zero write keys, API keys, or write authorization endpoints (/api/local/authorize) are implemented or requested.
Outages do not trigger requests to api.zotero.org; fallback remains local/manual export.
Attachment paths must pass T1 root confinement and traversal checks; KAD computes its own SHA-256.
